title.zh: 可分动词：小词跑到句末

body_zh: 有些动词前面带一个小词，比如 opbellen（打电话给）、meenemen（带上）、aandoen（穿上）；原形里它们连在一起。
在普通的句子里，变位的动词在第二位，小词放到句末：Ik bel je morgen op. Ik neem mijn bril mee.
和 wil、kan、moet 一起用时，原形放在句末、不分开：Ik wil je morgen opbellen.
body_en: Some verbs start with a small word, such as opbellen (to call), meenemen (to take along) and aandoen (to put on); in the infinitive they are written as one word.
In a normal sentence the conjugated verb is in second place and the small word goes to the end: Ik bel je morgen op. Ik neem mijn bril mee.
With wil, kan or moet, the infinitive goes to the end and stays in one piece: Ik wil je morgen opbellen.

examples.nl: Doe je jas aan, het is koud.
examples.en: Put your coat on, it's cold.
